info.title: Joinly API
info.description:
REST API for Joinly: teachers create classrooms, students join by QR or 6-digit code.

**Auth.** Exchange a Google ID token at `POST /v1/auth/google` for an access token (15 min JWT) and a rotating refresh token (30 days). Send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. On `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED`, call `POST /v1/auth/refresh` once and retry.

**Errors.** Every error is RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`.

post.summary: Sign in with a Google ID token
post.description:
Public.

Verifies the Google ID token server-side. Returning users are signed in. A new user must send `role`; without it the API answers 422 ROLE_REQUIRED and the app resends the same token with the chosen role.

post.summary: Sign in as a seeded demo account (review builds only)
post.description:
Public.

Mounted only when DEMO_LOGIN_ENABLED=true; otherwise 404. Signs in as the seeded demo teacher or demo student.
